RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly be estimated from these facts

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a process issue, but it is not proof of discrimination. Your qualifications are strong; however, a leadership role may also prioritize management and regulatory experience. The announcement does not establish his full qualifications or how candidates were assessed.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the bank’s panel-composition policy. You can neutrally ask how fairness was safeguarded with an all-male panel.

The unanswered request warrants follow-up, not an inference of bias. Keep records and check local complaint deadlines promptly; rights to explanations and rules about panel composition vary by jurisdiction.
